$comment: The devcloud profile both sides read: a repository declares what its operations need (this file describes the shape), agentq places the work, and infra/devcloud/images bakes the families. One source of truth - this directory - for the schema, the validator and the toolchain list.

toolchains.description: Image family names, without the devcloud-ci- prefix. Every name must be one the image bakery declares; a lane that asks for a family nobody bakes must fail here rather than at 3 a.m. on a VM that cannot build.

os.description: Hard constraint: a Windows lane cannot be placed on a Linux VM whatever the toolchains say.

concurrency.description: How many jobs of this lane one VM may run at once. 1 means the lane needs the machine to itself for its duration.

dedicated.description: true = this lane's VM is not shared with another repository, even when idle.

why.description: The reason a reader cannot infer from the numbers. Required when dedicated is true, or when concurrency is 1.

keep.description: Paths that survive the workspace clean between jobs. Everything else is rebuilt, which is what keeps a lane honest.

secrets.description: Secret Manager entry names the lane needs, resolved into the job environment. Names only: a value in this file is a bug, not a convenience.
